_concept: ANN: THE BUSINESS ANALYST — fausse bande-annonce hollywoodienne, humoristique, pour les 25 ans d'ancienneté de Ann (Business Analyst). Ton épique + décalé. ~2 min au montage final.

clips.name: 01_calme_avant_tempete
clips.prompt: Cinematic slow push-in on a calm business analyst at her desk holding a coffee, gentle steam rising from the cup, soft warm morning light through office windows, she looks up with a confident knowing smile. Photorealistic, shallow depth of field, the calm before the storm.

clips.name: 02_avalanche_demandes
clips.prompt: Comedic cinematic shot: dozens of urgent email and chat notifications pop up rapidly across the screens around her, sticky notes fluttering, papers swirling. She stays composed with a slight raised eyebrow. Fast subtle camera shake, dramatic office lighting, photorealistic, humorous tone.

clips.name: 03_appel_urgence
clips.prompt: Dramatic movie-trailer zoom on the analyst holding a phone to her ear, eyes narrowing with focus as an urgent request comes in, blurred colleague rushing in the background. Tense cinematic lighting, photorealistic, high stakes feeling played for fun.

clips.name: 04_heroine_se_leve
clips.prompt: Epic low-angle hero shot: the analyst rises from her chair with determination, hair and clothing moving in slow motion, a lens flare sweeping across the frame, glowing screens behind her. Cinematic blockbuster lighting, photorealistic, the hero rises.

clips.name: 05_super_pouvoirs
clips.prompt: The analyst faces multiple monitors as dashboards light up one by one — finance, sales, benchmark, operations — charts and graphs animating to life, data reflected in her glasses. Sweeping cinematic camera move, glowing blue and gold light, photorealistic, superhero energy.

clips.name: 06_clavier_epique
clips.prompt: Extreme close-up of hands typing furiously fast on a keyboard, faint sparks and energy trails, dramatic slow motion bursts, glowing screen light. Cinematic, photorealistic, intense and a little over-the-top for comedic effect.

clips.name: 07_revelation_whoaaaw
clips.prompt: The analyst presents a massive perfect dashboard to a meeting room; colleagues stare in awe, jaws dropping. A burst of light reveals the screen, slow dramatic camera push-in. Triumphant cinematic lighting, photorealistic, the whoaaaw moment.

clips.name: 08_triomphe_confettis
clips.prompt: The whole team applauds and cheers around the analyst, golden confetti falling in slow motion, warm celebratory light, big smiles, a 25 years celebration. Cinematic, photorealistic, joyful triumphant finale.
